prompt.v: A rectangle is 1 cm longer than it is wide, and its perimeter is 18 cm. Which equation gives the width, w?

problems.explain: The length is w + 1. A perimeter goes round all four sides, two widths and two lengths: 2w + 2(w + 1) = 18. w(w + 1) would be its area.

problems.explain: The length is w + 3. A perimeter goes round all four sides, two widths and two lengths: 2w + 2(w + 3) = 38. w(w + 3) would be its area.
